flagged.evidence: The Definition calls the annihilation formula's tensor extension the bounded map of [[lem-nrqm-composites-bounded-tensor-maps]]. That supplier's Statement requires “S∈B(H,H'), T∈B(K,K') be bounded linear operators” before asserting the extension. The Definition does not establish the bound for C_h(v)=⟨h,v⟩₂ before invoking that result. Also, the raw tensor map has target ℂ ⊗̂ H^{⊗(n−1)}, while the displayed formula uses H^{⊗(n−1)} without identifying the scalar tensor factor. The asserted sector maps are not established by the cited construction as written.

The title promises “joint spectrum.” The Statement constructs E(B), and proof step 4.1 says its indicators give the joint spectral projections, but the item never defines or characterizes the joint-spectrum set. The construction of a joint PVM and coordinate multipliers does not by itself supply the spectrum claim promised by the title.
